name: Attorney Bar / License Number
description: Detects attorney bar numbers and state license identifiers that link directly to public bar records. Bar numbers expose counsel identity and by extension can identify the matter and client. Maps to LEGAL_BAR_NUMBER canonical type.

metadata.pattern_note: Pattern requires explicit context cue (Bar No., License No., etc.) to reduce false positives. Precision is ~0.2 without context — mark as thin coverage. Do not rely on this rule alone for bar number detection.

effect.message: Attorney bar number tokenized to prevent counsel identification
